title: Lost draft card and being called up
summary: He and Freddie Greene lost their cards; writing for a new one got him drafted, the first in Basie's band to go.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Well now, you're with Basie right up until the time you go in the Army?

Yes. Until 1943. We had made a picture in California and I had lost my, my card. I don't know what, you know, your rating card, whatever your number is. And Freddie Greene had lost his out in California when we were making a movie. And he was walking down Hollywood Boulevard looking at some men's clothes and we were making a picture at Columbia studio. And for some reason the cop walked up to Freddie and says, where's your card? him Freddie didn't have a card. So they put/in jail because he didn't have, he had lost his card. Put him in jail.

We went back to the studio and everybody was waiting for Freddie, no Freddie. We waited and waited. Finally we had to go ahead and make the picture without Freddie because he stayed in jail overnight.
So I says, well I didn't have a card either. I'd lost mine. So I said I'd better write in for my new card. So I wrote in for a card. We were on the

way back to New York and we stopped in Kansas City at my sister's and I wrote in because I didn't want to be put in jail like Freddie did. So I said, I lost my card I wish you'd please send me a new one because I didn't know what I was, A-something.

When I got back to New York less than ten days later, I had revived the interest in me and they sent me a greetings, "greetings". If I had never written they probably would have never called me. But I woke them up by asking for a new card then I get "greetings". (LAUGHTER).
That's really a funny way of referring to induction as greetings. (LAUGHTER).

"Greetings." So I went in. I was the first to go in Basie's band. But I didn't mind really. I did mind but what the heck, you just, all you can do is make the best of it, so I just decided to take it as a rest.
